The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was created:

**Project:** `UniversityCourseCatalog` — .NET 10 Blazor Web App (static SSR, no interactivity needed)

**Structure:**
- **Models/** — `Department`, `Course`, `EnrollmentRequest` (with validation attributes)
- **Services/** — `CatalogService` (singleton with in-memory seed data, search/filter logic)
- **Pages:**
  - `/` — Homepage with featured courses cards and department links
  - `/courses` — Searchable, filterable course list (text search + department dropdown)
  - `/courses/{id}` — Course detail with description, schedule, credits, instructor bio, breadcrumb nav
  - `/enroll` — Enrollment request form (name, student ID, course select) with server-side validation and confirmation message

**Key decisions:**
- Static SSR only (no WebSocket/SignalR) — ideal for intranet with fast connectivity
- Standard HTML form for enrollment (no wizards/real-time validation per requirements)
- `CatalogService` registered as singleton with 15 courses across 6 departments
- Course list supports query string filtering (`?search=...&departmentId=...`)
- Enrollment page accepts `?courseId=` pre-selection from course detail page
